thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: High tail latency observed for tenant Solara (dedicated pool eu-west-1-ded-5). Paging eng-oncall. Symptoms: 95th/99th token latency spikes, elevated queue depth. Alert ID: INC-20231212-8792 :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): seeing it, joining now. which pool exactly?

ajay: confirmed — Solara on eu-west-1-ded-5, bespoke queue attached (solara-bespoke). 99th token latency ~1.8s -> baseline 0.25s. error rate ~12% 5xx from runtime timeouts.

jack (cust-eng): customer reports chat sessions time out mid-response. they started a flash promotion ~20m ago. they're seeing errors in the UI. escalated to account team.

maria (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) isolate Solara to a capped bespoke queue to stop noisy co-tenancy effects, 2) reduce max_batch_tokens for that tenant, 3) enable aggressive KV prefix caching for repeated prompts, 4) if needed, route to smaller model variant as fallback. executing now.

ajay: running isolation: `./ctl tenant isolate --tenant solara --pool eu-west-1-ded-5 --queue solara-limited --max-concurrency 8`

incident-bot: deploy-bot: job 4521 started: applying queue isolation for solara-limited.

maria (oncall): changed scheduler knobs for solara-limited: `max_batch_tokens=1024` (was 4096), `scheduler.window_ms=15` (was 50), `scheduler.max_delay_ms=8` (was 30).

ajay: also applied `batch_coalesce=false` for this tenant to avoid large batch delays during spiky burst.

maria (oncall): rolling config; watch tail latency and error rate. currently 99th at 1.2s and errors down to 7%.

elaine (next-oncall): pinged — I'll take handoff in 30m. what's the customer SLA impact?

jack (cust-eng): customer-level: some sessions lost, product saw ~20% degraded UX for last 25 minutes. They want ETA to resolution.

maria (oncall): current ETA: holding to see effect of reduced batch size + isolation. if error rate doesn't fall under 3% in 15m, we'll divert to fallback model `gpt-lite-1` for new requests only (no retrys).

ajay: metrics after first change: request rate unchanged, average tokens/batch dropped from 2.9k -> 700, 95th latency down to 600ms, errors 3.8% and still trending down. good signal.

maria (oncall): enabling prefix/KV cache for Solara: `PATCH /api/v1/tenants/solara/cache` payload: ```json
{
  "prefix_caching": true,
  "cache_ttl_seconds": 900,
  "cache_key_strategy": "prompt_hash_v2"
}
```

deploy-bot: cache update job 4522 succeeded.

ajay: running quick sanity: tail latency steady at ~450ms, errors 1.6%. customer still has some UX errors from prior failures but new requests are healthy.

jack (cust-eng): relayed to customer — they appreciate rapid response, will monitor UX. asked for a brief incident summary for postmortem.

maria (oncall): creating quick incident summary + runbook notes. key changes: isolated to solara-limited queue, reduced `max_batch_tokens=1024`, tightened scheduler windows, disabled batch coalesce, enabled prefix cache.

elaine (next-oncall): handoff notes requested. I'll take from here. should we schedule a controlled canary rollback of batch_coalesce=false? concern it may cost more tokens.

maria (oncall): agree — action items for next-oncall: 1) monitor token cost delta (tag:cost/solara), 2) after 2 hours of stable metrics, re-enable batch_coalesce with canary: `cfg rollout --tenant solara --key batch_coalesce --value true --canary 5% --monitor latency,errors`, 3) coordinate with pricing team if cost > expected.

sre-bot: NOTE: created incident INC-20231212-8792 in PagerDuty, severity P2, linked runbook 'tenant-bespoke-batching'.

elaine (next-oncall): acknowledged. I'll take a 30m handoff then escalate to product if we need a long-term knob change. leaving the thread in case of regressions. :white_check_mark:

maria (oncall): handing off. brief: mitigations applied, metrics improving, customer notified, postmortem draft in #postmortems/solara-bespoke. I'll be available for 15m overlap on call.

jack (cust-eng): thanks team. customer will hold off broader traffic spike until we confirm stability. I'll update them with the postmortem link once ready.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (partial): mitigation in place, customer impact reduced. Incident will remain open for postmortem and billing review.
